item.title: Goat Life 0.4.0
item.description:
Your goat has discovered your windows. It has opinions about heights.

  • Life on top of your windows. The goat now walks along the tops of your windows, hops from one to the next when they're close enough, and comes back down the sensible way. Move or close a window from under it and it tumbles down and lands on its feet, slightly offended.
  • A healthy fear of heights. Big jumps make it stop at the edge and peer over. Sometimes it works up the nerve; sometimes it backs away and finds the stairs.
  • Call it over. Wiggle your pointer side to side anywhere on the screen and the goat comes to find you, hopping across windows if it can.
  • Always something to eat. When it's hungry and there's nothing nearby, a little patch of grass sprouts for it, even up on a window. No more grazing on nothing.
  • Lighter and quieter. Goat Life uses a fraction of the memory it did, barely touches the processor while the goat is resting, steps aside for full-screen apps, and no longer switches on Game Mode.
